body:
## Stream247 1.1.2

### Added

- Cache-backed Twitch VOD playback so archive assets are verified locally before playout uses them.
- Persistent local relay/uplink publishing mode so program playout failures no longer directly own the external RTMP session.

### Changed

- Scheduled output reconnect ownership moved to the uplink path, keeping the default Twitch reconnect cadence at 48 hours.
- Production image pins and release guidance now target v1.1.2 with the pinned MediaMTX relay image.

### Validation

- Local pnpm validate passed before tagging.
- Main CI passed and published main-55958e4 snapshot artifacts.
- Release workflow passed and published v1.1.2 GHCR images for web, worker, and playout.
name: Stream247 1.1.2
